test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the words are related to each other in the same way the given words are related.

Whisper : Singing : Sound
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• The sound is produced when we whisper and when we are singing.

Similarly,

 
• **The Magazines and Books are printed or produced to Read.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Magazine : Book : Read".**
